text:
Tess (Design): Quick copy check for the rate-limit toast. Current toast says: \"Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.\" Users and support want clearer guidance + a link to retry/backoff suggestions. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/ratelimit-toast.png

Ibrahim (ENG): Backend returns headers: X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch) and X-RateLimit-Remaining. We can show a human-friendly retry hint like \"try again in 12s\" when reset is available. Otherwise show generic guidance.

Noah (PM): Prefer calm, actionable language. Avoid jargon. Suggested short toast: \"Too many requests. Try again in 12s or see tips.\" with a small \"Tips\" link to docs. Also track how often users click the tips link.

Samira (A11y): For screen readers, make the toast role=\"status\" and include the retry ETA in the announcement. If we include a link, ensure it is focusable and has descriptive text like \"Rate limit tips\" not just \"Tips\". Also avoid live-announcing repetitive toasts.

Tess (Design): Proposed variants:
- Variant A (with ETA): \"Too many requests. Try again in 12 seconds. [Rate limit tips]\"
- Variant B (no ETA): \"Too many requests. Try again later. [Rate limit tips]\"
Tone: short, calm. Use \"Try again in X seconds\" instead of \"Please wait\".

Ibrahim (ENG): Implementation: if X-RateLimit-Reset present and less than 2 minutes, compute seconds and show Variant A. Else Variant B. Will include aria-live polite and role=status.

Noah (PM): Also add a tooltip on the API error card that explains exponential backoff and suggested retry windows. But keep toast minimal.

Samira (A11y): Also ensure keyboard users can dismiss the toast with Escape and that focus is not stolen. For the link, include sr-only context: \"Opens rate limit documentation in a new tab.\" 

Tess (Design): Great. I'll add copy to the component story: primary toast text as Variant A/B and accessible link label \"Rate limit tips (opens docs)\". Will merge after PR review.

deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/rate-limit-toast/v1 (expires in 48h) :package:

Ibrahim (ENG): PR: https://git.redwood/pr/5378  includes ETA logic, aria attributes, and tests. Tagging @Samira @Tess for review.

Samira (A11y): Quick pass looks good. One nit: announce only when ETA changes, not on repeated identical toasts.

Tess (Design): Thanks all  merging after nit. :thumbsup:
